data.long_meaning: The name Rudiger is derived from the Germanic elements 'hrod' meaning 'fame' and 'wig' meaning 'war'. This name was borne by several early medieval figures, including a Frankish count and a bishop of Cologne. It was also the name of a legendary hero of the Nibelungenlied, a 13th-century German epic poem. The name Rudiger carries the meaning “Famous spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rudiger usually hope their child will grow to embody famous spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
